content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends moderate-intensity statin therapy for patients requiring a reduction in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) levels by 30–49%. The following statin medications and dosages are included in this category: Atorvastatin at a dosage of 10–20 mg. Rosuvastatin at a dosage of 5–10 mg. Simvastatin at a dosage of 20–40 mg. Pravastatin at a dosage of 40–80 mg. Lovastatin at a dosage of 40 mg. Fluvastatin XL at a dosage of 80 mg.
